 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LaMelo Ball and the Minnesota Timberwolves host Cooper Flagg and the Dallas Mavericks on Thursday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 Dallas enters the matchup with a 7-4 record and is on a three-game winning streak, most recently defeating the Indiana Pacers 125-122 on Monday. Forward Flagg scored 43 points on 16-for-25 shooting from the field while securing a game-high 10 rebounds and dishing a team-high six assists. Guard Kyrie Irving scored 35 points on 11-for-18 shooting from the field and 7-for-10 shooting from 3-point range.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mavericks vs Timberwolves TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Dallas Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg (32).Troy Taormina-Imagn Images
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Venue: Target Center, Minneapolis
 TV: DirecTV, NBA TV, MavsTV, KFAA-TV
 Live stream: YouTube TV, Sling TV, Fubo
 Fans can watch the game for free most readily through the Fubo app. Another avenue for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free trial that can be canceled before five days.
 Minnesota is sitting at 8-3 and is on a four-game winning streak, most recently defeating the Utah Jazz 115-100 on Sunday. Guard Ayo Dosunmu scored 26 points, while guard Ball scored 24 points and dished a team-high five assists. Center Rudy Gobert had a double-double with 10 points and 15 rebounds, while forward Jaden McDaniels scored 16 points and grabbed six rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For Dallas, forward Morez Johnson Jr. is a game-time decision with a lower-leg injury, while center Dereck Lively II (foot), forward Tarik Biberovic (heel) and forward Sergio De Larrea (knee) are out for the game. For Minnesota, star guard Anthony Edwards (knee) and guard Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) are out for the game.
